name: dx-devops
description: Operate Salesforce DevOps Center projects, pipelines, and work items and configure their automated testing: create/list/update projects, manage pipeline definitions and work items, configure test pipelines and suite assignments, run stage test suites, and analyze test failures. Use for DevOps Center project setup, pipeline administration, work-item tracking, test-stage configuration, suite execution, quality-gate reruns, or pipeline failure analysis.
